(() => { const cv = document.getElementById('pmap'), r = cv.getBoundingClientRect(), h = window.G.pmHits.find(q => q.kind === 'u' && q.s.id === 'konstablerwache'); const cx = r.left + h.x * r.width / cv.width, cy = r.top + h.y * r.height / cv.height; window.__lockSeen = false; document.addEventListener('pointerlockchange', () => { if (document.pointerLockElement && document.getElementById('menu').style.display === 'flex') window.__lockSeen = true; }); for (const t of ['mousedown', 'mouseup']) cv.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent(t, { bubbles: true, clientX: cx, clientY: cy, button: 0 })); return [cx, cy].map(Math.round).join(','); })()
